messages:
Aisha Khan: morning handoff — quick summary for the 07:00->15:00 shift. overnight we had a brief customer-impacting event (~30m) where a subset of inference hosts started returning 503s due to redis eviction storms. i'm primary for this shift.

Connor Li: noted. what is current status? any active pages?

incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: #INC-2026-REDIS-EVICT at 2026-03-20T06:12:08Z — Severity: P2 — PagerDuty escalation sent.

Aisha Khan: incident resolved as of ~06:42Z after fallback and cache warmup. root cause suspected: long-running KV cache keys + sudden traffic spike from a customer experiment hitting long-sequence prompts. eviction pressure triggered degraded path in our redis cluster, which hit the host-side cache fallback and caused a soft-fail loop.

Samir Patel: +1 on that. i triaged the logs and saw eviction rate spike from 0.1/s -> 12/s on shard redis-7b. As eviction increased, our local retry loop caused short tight retry bursts which overloaded the control plane leading to increased 503s.

Priya Reddy: customer impact: ~12 customers experienced transient 5xx for ~8-10 requests each, mostly interactive chat workloads. no long-running queries lost. we've opened a CS ticket to notify affected customers and added mitigations.

Aisha Khan: actions taken during incident:
- disabled aggressive client-side retry patch (rolled back to conservative backoff)
- enabled redis eviction prober rule to throttle client writes when eviction_rate > 5/s
- temporary routing to cold-kv hosts to spread load for 20m window
- warmed prefix cache for top 10 callers

Connor Li: what about runbook pointers? which docs to follow if this reoccurs?

Aisha Khan: runbook links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/redis-eviction (runbook v2) and ops playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/kv-cache-fallback. key snippets:
```
# quick mitigations
1) set feature flag: kv_retry_aggressive = false
2) add route: route.kv.prefer_cold = true
3) scale redis-shard by +2 nodes (if cluster autoscaling fails)
```

Samir Patel: logs and query to reproduce observed pattern (for oncall notes):
```
SELECT count(*) FROM eviction_events WHERE rate > 5 AND shard = 'redis-7b' AND timestamp > now() - interval '1 hour';
```

Priya Reddy: coverage note: i'm secondary until 12:00 UTC, then Connor will be secondary. primary rotation after handoff: Aisha -> Samir (overnight follow-ups) -> Connor. please ack.

Connor Li: ack. i'll be secondary starting 12:00 UTC and will take ownership of follow-ups regarding dashboards/alerts.

Aisha Khan: current open items for next shift:
- validate the eviction prober rule behaves under synthetic load (Samir) — action: run bench scenario by 10:30 UTC and post results in this thread.
- update runbook to include the new throttle check and the conservative retry config (Priya) — action: push PR to internal/docs today.
- follow up with infra team on autoscaler logs for redis-7b to ensure scaling triggers are healthy (Connor) — action: open infra ticket if autoscaler didn't trigger.

ops-bot: DEPLOYMENT NOTICE: rolled back client-retry-feature flag at 2026-03-20T06:20Z by @Aisha.

Samir Patel: status update 09:45 UTC — ran synthetic load per plan: eviction prober tripped at expected threshold, cold-kv routing reduced eviction burst by ~60%. results uploaded: https://internal.artifacts/evict-test-1795004321. no regression seen in latency p50/p95 for our top callers.

Priya Reddy: PR submitted for runbook updates: https://redwood.internal/prs/3456 — includes steps and playbook clarifications. please review.

Connor Li: infra ticket created: INFRA-7629 — investigating why autoscaler didn't add redis nodes earlier; linked logs and heap profiles.

Aisha Khan: coverage gaps: night coverage for APAC window has fewer engineers on rotation next week. flagged with oncall-manager to arrange a backup. if you are available for oncall overlap (19:00-23:00 UTC) please ping me.

Samir Patel: noted — i can cover 20:00-23:00 UTC on thursday.

Priya Reddy: next steps before my handoff at 12:00: merge runbook PR, confirm CS messages drafted, confirm no open alerts.

Aisha Khan: final notes: severity downgraded to P3, incident closed but monitoring for 24 hours. please keep this thread as canonical handoff log for the shift. if you pick up any follow-ups, append a short line with your name and time.

Connor Li: thanks team. i'll post an end-of-shift summary at 15:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

Aisha Khan: handing off now — primary = Samir Patel, secondary = Connor Li. coverage notes included above.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: #INC-2026-REDIS-EVICT status=resolved severity=P3 closed_by=Aisha Khan
